result.topic_en: Formula-only calculations: duplication formulas for quantities s and t indexed by x, a family of quadratic relations among alpha with shifted indices, and the elimination of x between two quadratic equations to obtain their resultant.
result.transcription:

methods.what: Substitution/transformation formulas for parameters p, q, r, m in terms of p^0, q^0, r^0, m^0
Duplication formulas for s and t (index x to 2x)
Symmetric biquadratic relation linking alpha_m and alpha_{m±x} via s_x, t_x
methods.quote: $(\alpha_m^2 + \alpha_{m\pm x}^2) s_x^2 + (\alpha_m^2 \alpha_{m\pm x}^2) b + c - t_x \alpha_m \alpha_{m\pm x} = 0$

methods.what: Same relation rewritten as a quadratic in alpha_m
methods.quote: $(s_x^2 + b\alpha_{m\pm x}^2)\alpha_m^2 - t_x \alpha_{m\pm x} \alpha_m + (\alpha_{m\pm x}^2 s_x^2 + c) = 0$

methods.what: Elimination of x from two quadratics giving the resultant (common-root condition)
Resultant rewritten in a square-completed form
Discriminant-type expression ac - b^2/4 for the quadratic in alpha_m
methods.quote: $= s_x^2 \left[ b\alpha_{m\pm x}^4 + c + \alpha_{m\pm x}^2 \left[ \frac{a + s_x^4}{s_x^2} - \frac{1}{4}\frac{t_x^2}{s_x^2} \right] \right]$
